features.name: high_glucose_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for elevated plasma glucose levels above 140.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct split for tree models to isolate elevated glucose levels, reducing tree depth.

features.name: bmi_age_interaction
features.description: Product of body mass index and age, capturing the combined effect of aging and body mass.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows tree models to capture the nonlinear interaction between age and BMI in a single split.

features.name: insulin_glucose_ratio
features.description: Ratio of serum insulin to plasma glucose, indicating insulin response relative to circulating glucose.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes the relative relationship between insulin and glucose, which trees cannot easily compute via orthogonal splits.

features.name: is_zero_insulin
features.description: Binary indicator for zero values in the insulin column, which often represent missing measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly flags potential missing data, allowing the tree to treat zero values differently from true low values.

features.name: is_zero_skin_fold
features.description: Binary indicator for zero values in the triceps skin fold thickness column.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the tree model isolate rows with unrecorded skin fold thickness without searching for the zero threshold.

features.name: pedigree_risk_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucketing of the diabetes pedigree function into low, medium, and high tiers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups continuous pedigree scores into discrete risk tiers, simplifying the decision boundary for tree splits.

features.name: blood_pressure_category
features.description: Categorizes diastolic blood pressure into low (<60), normal (60-90), and high (>90).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides pre-computed clinical thresholds for blood pressure, reducing the number of splits needed to isolate abnormal ranges.

features.name: pregnancy_age_ratio
features.description: Number of pregnancies divided by age, representing the frequency of pregnancies over the patient's lifetime.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes pregnancy count by age, providing a rate that is more comparable across different age groups.

features.name: metabolic_syndrome_score
features.description: Composite score counting the presence of high BMI (>30), high blood pressure (>85), and high glucose (>130).
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple risk factors into a single monotonic feature, allowing the tree to split on cumulative metabolic risk.

features.name: glucose_bmi_product
features.description: Product of plasma glucose and body mass index.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the synergistic effect of elevated glucose and high BMI, which a tree would otherwise need multiple deep splits to approximate.

features.name: age_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucketing of age into young adult (<30), middle-aged (30-50), and older adult (>50).
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretizes age into demographic groups, helping tree models generalize across broad age brackets.

features.name: health_status_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall metabolic health based on the combination of glucose, BMI, blood pressure, and age, scored from 0 (optimal) to 10 (severe risk).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear evaluation of patient health that captures complex clinical patterns beyond simple arithmetic combinations.
